item.title: Ariana Grande Achieves Seventh No. 1 Album on Billboard 200 With ‘petal’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update! We've got some exciting news from the Billboard charts. Ariana Grande has just landed her seventh number one album on the Billboard 200 chart with her new release, 'petal'."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "With 295,000 equivalent album units earned in the US, 'petal' marks Grande's biggest week by units in the 2020s. It's also her biggest week by pure album sales in over a decade. This puts Grande in an impressive group, tying for the fifth-most number one albums among solo women, alongside Lady Gaga and Janet Jackson."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "Grande's new album has debuted at number one on both the Top Album Sales and Top Streaming Albums charts. The album's sales and streaming numbers are impressive, with 168,000 album sales and 128.83 million on-demand streams in its first week. The vinyl sales alone totaled 96,000, making it Grande's best week on vinyl ever."
[Short music clip plays]
Host: "This is just the latest achievement for Grande, who is currently on her 'The Eternal Sunshine Tour'. Her new album was announced back in April, and was preceded by her ninth number one single on the Billboard Hot 100 chart, 'Hate That I Made You Love Me'. We'll be keeping an eye on the charts to see what's next for Grande and other top artists."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to this music update. For more chart news and updates, follow @billboard and @billboardcharts on social media. We'll catch you in the next episode!"
